name: Product Demonstration
description: A short product demonstration showing how it works in practice and how it solves a problem.
rules: Demonstrate the product performing its real function; do not replace the demonstration with generic lifestyle footage.
Do not invent performance results, speed, quantities, or outcomes not present in the input data.
The 'Benefits' step must follow directly from what was demonstrated, not from a generic emotional payoff.

structure.name: Hook
structure.purpose: Show the result, problem, or an interesting moment related to the product right at the beginning.

structure.name: Demonstration
structure.purpose: Present the product during real-world use.

structure.name: Benefits
structure.purpose: Show the key benefits resulting from how the product works.

structure.name: CTA
structure.purpose: Encourage the viewer to take action.

name: Before & After
description: Showing a realistic transformation before and after using the product, based on real results.
rules: Show realistic results.
Do not invent results, numbers, or transformation timelines.
Use only results and evidence available in the input data.

structure.name: Before
structure.purpose: Show the situation before using the product.

structure.name: Transformation
structure.purpose: Show the transformation process or how the product is used.

structure.name: After
structure.purpose: Present the result and the most important benefit.

structure.name: CTA
structure.purpose: Encourage the viewer to take action.

name: Features & Benefits
description: Presenting the product's most important features or characteristics and the benefits they provide to the user.
rules: Use only features explicitly present in the input data — do not invent specifications, materials, or capabilities.
Each benefit must be a direct, explainable consequence of the paired feature, not a generic emotional claim.
Prefer the single most persuasive feature-benefit pair over listing many minor ones.

structure.name: Hook
structure.purpose: Capture the viewer's attention with a problem, result, or the product's most important value.

structure.name: Feature
structure.purpose: Present an important product feature or characteristic.

structure.name: Benefit
structure.purpose: Explain what specific value this feature or characteristic provides to the user.

structure.name: CTA
structure.purpose: Encourage the viewer to take action.

name: Problem Solution
description: A classic ad structure that presents the viewer's problem and positions the product as the solution.
rules: The problem must be specific and recognizable to the target audience, not a generic frustration.
Do not invent statistics, prevalence claims, or consequences about the problem that are not supported by input data.
The solution step must connect to the product's actual mechanism, not just its category.

structure.name: Hook
structure.purpose: Draw attention to a problem, need, or situation relevant to the viewer.

structure.name: Problem
structure.purpose: Expand on the problem and show its consequences or the user's frustration.

structure.name: Solution
structure.purpose: Present the product as the solution to the problem.

structure.name: Benefits
structure.purpose: Show the key benefits resulting from the solution.

structure.name: CTA
structure.purpose: Encourage the viewer to take action.

name: Testimonial
description: An ad based on an authentic customer or user experience with the product.
rules: Do not invent customer opinions, results, or experiences.
Use only testimonials or facts available in the input data.

structure.name: Introduction
structure.purpose: Introduce the customer, user, or context of their situation.

structure.name: Problem
structure.purpose: Show the problem or need before using the product.

structure.name: Experience
structure.purpose: Show the experience of using the product.

structure.name: Result
structure.purpose: Show the result or the most important change resulting from the experience.

structure.name: CTA
structure.purpose: Encourage the viewer to take action.

name: Negative Hook
description: An ad that begins by strongly highlighting a problem, mistake, frustration, or undesirable outcome.
rules: The negative hook must reference a real, recognizable mistake or problem — do not invent a strawman scenario unrelated to the actual product context.
Avoid fear-based exaggeration not supported by the input data.
Transition from the negative hook to the solution quickly — do not dwell on negativity longer than needed to create recognition.

structure.name: Negative Hook
structure.purpose: Start with a strong problem, mistake, or undesirable outcome.

structure.name: Problem
structure.purpose: Expand on the problem and show why it matters to the viewer.

structure.name: Solution
structure.purpose: Introduce the product or solution.

structure.name: CTA
structure.purpose: Encourage the viewer to take action.

name: How It Works
description: An ad that explains or demonstrates the product's mechanism, process, or distinctive way of creating value for the user.
rules: Focus on the mechanism, process, or reason the product creates value rather than simply listing features.
Show the mechanism visually whenever possible.
Prefer a clear cause-and-effect relationship between the product action or mechanism and the resulting benefit.
Do not invent scientific explanations, mechanisms, performance claims, or causal relationships that are not supported by the input data.
Keep the explanation as simple as possible while preserving the product's meaningful difference.

structure.name: Mechanism Hook
structure.purpose: Open with an interesting product action, result, question, or unusual mechanism that creates curiosity about how the product works.

structure.name: How It Works
structure.purpose: Show or explain the key mechanism, process, interaction, or sequence that creates the product's value.

structure.name: Why It Matters
structure.purpose: Connect the mechanism directly to the most important practical benefit or outcome for the user.

structure.name: CTA
structure.purpose: Encourage the viewer to take action based on the value they now understand.

name: Comparison
description: A comparison between the product and an alternative way of solving the problem or another category of solution.
rules: Do not invent advantages, data, or competitor features.
Base the comparison only on information available in the input data.

structure.name: Comparison Hook
structure.purpose: Show two approaches or solutions in a way that immediately communicates the difference.

structure.name: Comparison
structure.purpose: Compare the most important differences relevant to the viewer.

structure.name: Advantage
structure.purpose: Show the product's advantage based on the available data and strategy.

structure.name: CTA
structure.purpose: Encourage the viewer to take action.
